title: Weather-Aware Domain Adaptation for Street-View Weather Recognition
abstract: arXiv:2610.02000v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Adverse conditions such as rain, snow, fog, and dust remain challenging for camera-based perception in autonomous driving. We study multi-class weather recognition from street-view images under domain shift, where most available training data come from non-street-view sources that differ markedly from real driving scenes. We propose Weather-Aware Adversarial Discriminative Domain Adaptation (WA-ADDA), which conditions the domain discriminator on predicted weather to promote features that are both domain-invariant and weather-sensitive. We also assemble a multi-dataset benchmark by unifying diverse non-street-view weather collections as sources and real street-view images as targets, and define a standardized evaluation protocol with macro accuracy as the primary metric. translated_title: 面向街景天气识别的天气感知域自适应方法
translated_abstract: 摘要（arXiv:2610.02000v1，公告类型：cross）：雨、雪、雾、尘等恶劣天气条件对自动驾驶中基于摄像头的感知仍然是一个挑战。我们研究了域偏移下基于街景图像的多类别天气识别问题，其中大多数可用的训练数据来自与真实驾驶场景差异显著的非街景数据源。我们提出了天气感知对抗判别域自适应方法（WA-ADDA），该方法将预测的天气作为条件输入域判别器，从而学习既具有域不变性又对天气敏感的特征。我们还构建了一个多数据集基准，将多样化的非街景天气数据集统一作为源域，将真实街景图像作为目标域，并定义了以宏平均准确率为主要指标的标准化评估协议。在多种骨干网络（ResNet-50、EfficientNet、VGG、DenseNet）上，WA-ADDA 均持续提升了街景数据的识别性能，并在具有挑战性的天气条件下取得了强劲的各类别召回率。
tldr: 提出天气感知对抗判别域自适应方法WA-ADDA，通过将预测天气作为域判别器的条件来学习既域不变又天气敏感的特征，并构建多数据集基准，显著提升街景天气识别性能。
